name: Fat Pack | 4g Prepackaged Flower | Permanent Runtz
description: Fat Pack: The Original 4 Gram Eighth – a half gram better. Permanent Marker x Pineapple Fruz come together to create Permanent Runtz, a dessert-forward strain with sweet cherry undertones. Its effects lean relaxing and stress-relieving, paired with a joyful cerebral lift. Myrcene, Caryophyllene, and Limonene power both the flavor and calming vibes.
